title: Palace wants budget watchdogs to scrutinize 2027 budget 'red flags'

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday urged budget watchdogs to report any “red flags” they uncover in the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027. At a briefing, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. would take note of any alleged anomalies flagged by groups reviewing the proposed budget. READ: House to consult budget watchdogs “Sa mga nagbabantay ng budget, kung mayroon po kayong mismong kopya na inyong nakita at napansin na red flag ay ipagbigay-alam lang po ninyo sa amin, bigyan po ninyo kami ng kopya, mismo ang PCO [Presidential Communications Office] dahil kakailanganin din po ito ng Pangulo,” she said.
